resources.string: The planned footprint touches or crosses a boundary, or its plan is not qualified. Its effective area is unknown, so per-hectare values are unavailable. Tree observations remain available.

This action closes only the marking inventory for this plot, preserving its observations, parameters, results and recorded positions. Other plots remain independent. A correction creates a new revision.
Reported position accuracy: %1$s to %2$s m. Pauses and interruptions remain separate.
No GPS route was recorded for this inventory.
The recorded GPS route does not pass format or accuracy checks and is excluded from the map export.
Results linked to a specific survey, with their sources and limitations.
Select a parcel to review its campaigns. Visits are not automatically added together.
One campaign and revision at a time. Corrections and earlier visits remain separate.
These old observations are not linked to a campaign. Filtering by date does not establish a single visit or rule out duplicates.
Measurements, parameters and results retained at closure. A correction creates a new revision.
The measurements were closed without stored summary results. Current calculations do not replace this version, and a closed results PDF cannot be exported.
No stems in this survey. Add measurements during tree marking to see results here.
Plot areas are not added together: coverage and possible overlaps have not been established. Per-hectare indicators remain unavailable.
The survey and parcel areas differ. Check them before using per-hectare results.
Per-hectare indicators concern only stems recorded on this area; they do not automatically describe the whole stand.
Method selected by the user. Suitability for the species, territory and stand must be checked. No regional tariff is inferred from GPS.
Existing volume engine: %1$s. Results are estimates using retained parameters; no additional scientific precision is claimed.
Your selection is saved. Calculating volume requires a documented method, verified coefficients, an applicable domain and compatible measurements. Your observations remain available.
Volume remains unavailable; it does not constitute a validated commercial quantity.
%1$d / %2$d stems have a recorded value. This amount is not a local market price or guaranteed revenue.
No values recorded. No fallback price or arbitrary product percentage is applied.
Qualified local rates, operations and conditions are needed. Costs and the net result remain unknown.
Tree marking describes recorded trees. It is insufficient to diagnose the entire stand, predict its development or produce a GSIE recommendation.
Map packs do not yet supply qualified local volume or cost rates. No regional price is fabricated.
No detailed reference recorded. Measurements alone do not establish validation.
The summary could not be loaded or closed. Your data is retained. Reload the page before trying again.
This stops the campaign and retains all its measurements, parameters and results. It applies to the entire campaign, even when viewing one plot. Corrections must create a new revision.
Exports concern this campaign. GeoJSON includes only stem points with actual coordinates.
No located stems in this survey.
The PDF for this version could not be archived. Retained measurements and results remain available.
GeoSylva · observation report · partial results identified
This revision’s PDF is retained locally
A class height is an explicitly recorded estimate, distinct from individual measured tree heights.
Quality comes from entered assessments, without undocumented automatic classification.
Synthesis engine: %1$s. Results describe the recorded data; no volume is calculated without a qualified method.
